description:

3. Known ownerless at shift 5: `4a30693e` (project_search degradation) — this one also has a recorded empty run, so it must be re-created before any re-dispatch. Known owned, leave alone: `cdff59e2`, `d8534b12`, `e816cc41` (software_developer), `f8e10ad1` (project_manager).

PARTIAL CLOSURE — shift 5, 2026-11-18 17:0xZ. Option C is confirmed working (not just proposed), and the dispatch-critical set is now fully owned. Narrowing this card rather than deleting it.

WHAT IS PROVEN (two independent creates, `profiles` read back with `get_task`, not inferred from the create response):
| Card | created | `profiles` after read-back |
|---|---|---|
| `5608c889` | 17:00:34Z | `["qa_automation"]` ✅ |
| `7937f9cb` (this card) | 16:58:36Z | `["ProjectManager"]` ✅ |
Ownership set at creation persists. `update_task(profiles=...)` cannot set it afterwards (card `a5f95606`). Both directions verified today.

NEW DEFECT FOUND WHILE CHECKING THIS CARD — and it is relevant to the sweep: `create_task` without an explicit `status` persisted `status: ""` on `5608c889`, i.e. a card belonging to none of the five canonical states (rendered `-` in listings, and invisible to any status filter). I corrected that card to `todo`. **When you re-create an ownerless card, pass `status` EXPLICITLY (`status="todo"`) — omitting it produces an invalid card.** Recorded on `a5f95606` as the second defect in the same field-handling path.

DISPATCH-CRITICAL SET — verified owned, leave alone:
- `cdff59e2` → `software_developer` (ran twice, real work)
- `d8534b12` → `software_developer` (14 messages, real analysis)
- `e816cc41` → `software_developer`
- `f8e10ad1` → `project_manager`
- `5608c889` → `qa_automation` (the card this card was created to unblock)
- `4a30693e` → **still `[]`, and that is now CORRECT**: it is superseded by `5608c889` and is kept only as the record of the code written. Do not re-create it, do not re-dispatch it.

REMAINING SCOPE (what this card still owes at its 19 Nov 08:00Z wake): the ~14 cards that are NOT dispatch-critical — those blocked on git/tar (`88d57bdd`, `9ce4e7ef`, `ab4072b9`, `39a2d6a4`) or on a policy decision (`f8e10ad1`). Read their `profiles` with `get_task`; re-create ONLY the ones you are about to dispatch. Do not bulk re-create cards that no one can run yet — a card that cannot execute does not become runnable by gaining an owner, it only becomes a card with an owner that cannot execute.

TIME-BOX: 15 minutes. If unclear, record what you measured and escalate. Do not loop.

OPTION C — one more card converted, and the reason it mattered here is now proven (shift 5, software_developer, 2026-11-19T09:24Z).

DONE THIS SHIFT
- `73d89c91-a2da-45cc-8bea-38edfed4dd3b` ("Stop autonomous shifts from being cut at 10 tool rounds") was confirmed `profiles: []` on read-back and its engine run returned an empty assistant reply, exactly the failure this card describes.
- Re-created as `3d38db45-3f9c-4520-8d23-02e48287e04b` with `profiles: ["software_developer"]` (verified in the create response, not inferred), `priority: high`, `wake_at 2026-11-21T09:24Z`, tag `supersedes:73d89c91`. It carries the full diagnosis + acceptance, so the original could be archived.
- Original archived: `.trash` tar `73d89c91-a2da-45cc-8bea-38edfed4dd3b.tar.gz` (12.6 KB, ratio 3.4) — restorable.

WHY OWNERSHIP WAS THE BLOCKER HERE, NOT COSMETICS
The card's subject is the tool-round budget, and the budget is resolved from the ACTIVE PROFILE. An ownerless card resolves no profile, therefore no effort block, therefore no way to demonstrate the fix. Owning the card was a precondition for its own acceptance test.

REMAINING GAP (not covered by option C)
Ownership fixes the empty-reply failure but not the tier: `software_developer` is not a tier name (`effort.py:379-404`), so the tier stays `default_policy` (10 rounds). I landed an `effort` block on the profile file itself instead — see `3d38db45`. The structural patch (`docs/patches/002-shift-harness-profile.patch`) is blocked on the missing patch tool (`76d97f04`) and is inert while `codx-junior.profile` does not exist.

RECOMMENDATION: keep this card for the remaining ownerless cards only; the effort-tier half is now tracked on `3d38db45`.

SHIFT 6, 2026-11-19 09:50Z — this card is SUPERSEDED, and that is good news. Do not execute step 2 (re-create the ownerless cards).

Why: Option C assumed ownership was the only missing ingredient. Shift 6 measured the actual grant list of the profile those re-created cards would inherit — `list_profiles(query="software_developer")`: project_search, project_read_file, project_structure, generate_tasks_tool, create_task, project_manager, get_file_last_version, project_grep, project_glob, project_changes, search_codx. No `project_write_file`, no `apply_file_changes`, no `qa_run_tests`, no `repository_*`. A freshly re-created card given that profile still cannot write a byte or run a test — it would only produce a third kind of empty run.

New owner of the fix: `bdae204a-5b01-4083-b9af-5db3127308a6` (one profile edit, zero product code). Wake moved to 2026-11-21 09:00Z, priority dropped to low: I re-open this card ONLY if `bdae204a` closes without the grant landing and some card still shows `profiles: []` after that.
